entries.en: to be glad, to rejoice; gladness
to rejoice, to be glad
to be merry, to take pleasure; to enjoy oneself
entries.notes: R 栏作 ho，与 樂 的官话常读不合，疑原稿省略或污损；义依 H 与西语词头定。

entries.en: to be in high spirits, to rejoice

entries.zh: 游玩、闲逛；无牵挂地四处游荡
entries.en: to roam about for pleasure, to wander without a care
entries.notes: R 栏 siàu 与 遊 对音不合，疑污损或原稿另字；义依 H 与西语 sin cuidar 定。

entries.en: to rejoice, to be glad
to play, to disport oneself
entries.notes: R 栏 hiu/ru 两读存疑，取与 遊 相合之读。

entries.zh: 游玩、游览；出外游观取乐
entries.en: to go about sightseeing, to take one's pleasure abroad
entries.notes: H 第二字存疑（玩/範），R 作 guān 近 觀，词形未能定夺。

entries.en: to swim, to disport oneself in the water
to sport, to play about
entries.notes: 尖耍 非常见词形，依 R 栏 chiám zoa 与 耍 字定夺，确切词义存疑。

entries.en: to take one's ease and enjoy oneself, to relax in idleness
entries.notes: H 首字存疑（範/散），R 作 suàn 近 散；次字 賞 与 sio 不合，词形未定。

entries.zh: 打靶、射靶取乐；以射靶为戏
entries.en: to shoot at a mark for sport, to practise shooting for amusement
entries.notes: H 首字存疑（艶/靶），R 作 pà 近 靶，故取 靶標。

entries.zh: 尽兴至极、极为舒畅得意；日子过得极宽绰自在
entries.en: to be at the height of one's ease and merriment; to live very much at one's ease
entries.notes: 西语末尾 andar muy anchay 为混合语，义依 標到極 与 ancho（宽绰、自在）推定。

entries.en: to rejoice exceedingly, to be overjoyed
to be in high spirits, to be greatly delighted
entries.notes: 興彩 词形罕见，义依西语 mucho 与 R 栏推定。

entries.zh: 兴头上、兴致正高；快活得意
entries.en: to be in the flush of excitement, to be highly delighted
entries.notes: H 首字存疑（興/具），取 興頭 一词；R 作 hêng zau 与 頭 之声母不合。

entries.zh: 性情放野、恣意取乐〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to give oneself up to wild mirth; of a wild, unrestrained nature 〔original damaged; sense uncertain〕
entries.notes: L 栏有 [残]，R 作 se ya 与 性野 对音不合，语义无法定夺。

entries.en: to be free and easy, to roam carefree
to divert oneself, to pass the time pleasantly
entries.notes: H 次字存疑（遣/造），R 作 ghien 近 遣，故按 逍遣（即 消遣）之借写释义。

entries.en: to roam and play, to idle about for pleasure
to stroll at leisure, to saunter
to rejoice, to be glad (at good fortune)
